topics.label: Lecture introduction and the hallmarks of cancer framework
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's learning outcomes, relates the content to prior lectures, and sets up the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Deregulation of growth factor signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in pathways like Wnt/beta-catenin, RTK/Ras/MAPK, and PI3K drive sustained proliferation and resistance to growth-inhibitory signals.

topics.label: Differentiation blocks in hematological and epithelial cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how arrested differentiation maintains proliferative states in both blood malignancies and solid epithelial cancers.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the molecular mechanisms and regulatory proteins, such as p53, Bax, and BCL2, that cancer cells alter to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and intrinsic growth control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine telomere maintenance, senescence mechanisms, and p53-mediated stress responses, concluding with a recap of cell-intrinsic growth control hallmarks.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the Warburg effect, metabolic rewiring, and the role of metabolic enzyme mutations and oncometabolites in tumor biology.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the physiological requirement for new blood vessel recruitment in growing tumors and the regulatory balance between angiogenic activators and inhibitors.

topics.label: Metastatic dissemination and colonization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the biological steps, anatomical routes, clinical monitoring, and clonal genetics of cancer metastasis.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer delivers closing remarks on the cancer hallmarks literature, restates the core takeaways, and opens the floor to student questions.
